description: Connects a dietary supplement product to an enzyme activity class representing an ingredient it contains.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing this relationship; includes NHANES.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time this relationship was last created or updated.

common_properties.name: quantity
common_properties.description: Amounts of the contributing ingredients in the supplement product.
common_properties.notes: One element per contributor; quantity, unit, operator are index-aligned.

common_properties.name: unit
common_properties.description: Raw NHANES amount-unit codes; no unit label table is available in the source documentation.
common_properties.notes: One element per contributor; quantity, unit, operator are index-aligned.

common_properties.name: operator
common_properties.notes: One element per contributor; quantity, unit, operator are index-aligned.

common_properties.name: category
common_properties.description: Ingredient category: Vitamin, Mineral, Botanical, Other, or Amino acid. When contributing ingredients have different categories, the value is Other.

source_contributions.scope: Dietary supplement products reported by NHANES participants, with discrete enzyme ingredients represented by EC classes. Ingredients without an identified EC target are not represented by this relationship.
source_contributions.description: The NHANES Dietary Supplement Database Ingredient Information (DSII), published by CDC / National Center for Health Statistics, records product ingredients and their amounts. Different ingredients in a product can refer to the same EC class; their amounts, units, and operators remain separate entries in aligned lists. In the common single-ingredient case, each list has length 1.
